fact: In August 2025 a ministry official said the Digital Transformation Agenda 2022-2025 was being evaluated and updated, and listed completed projects such as a government intranet linking more than 344 sites, without measuring them against the Agenda's targets.
title: التحول الرقمي.. خدمات نوعية تُلبي تطلعات المواطنين وتبسط الإجراءات
